facts.fact: UNICEF Madagascar says that with the EU Joint Research Centre and the Ministry of Water, Hygiene and Sanitation it has set up a drought monitoring system for southern Madagascar using satellite rainfall and vegetation data (CHIRPS, MODIS), while noting Madagascar has no national drought monitoring system.
